description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillAPI class, which provides CRUD API endpoints for managing employee skills within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee skills, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee skills in ODHRM system, supporting CRUD operations with validation and Swagger documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee skill by employee number and skill ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all skills for a specified employee with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee skill record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee skill record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee skills based on IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Internal method to handle creation or update of EmployeeSkill entities based on request parameters.
